description: Mock interviewer turns. Each turn is one or more clips joined by pauses (pauses inside a question test that the whole question is kept). answerSeconds is the silence while the candidate answers. sendDelayMs is how long after the interviewer stops the send is pressed (100 = pressed almost at once, before VAD commits).

clips: Hi Satish, can you hear me okay?

what you've been working on recently.
